summary: Kymera Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of enrollment in its BROADEN2 Phase 2b trial of KT-621, an oral STAT6 degrader for atopic dermatitis, with topline data expected by year-end 2026—six months earlier than prior guidance. The registrant announced expected Phase 3 trial initiation by mid-2027 subject to regulatory discussions. This is a routine operational update on a clinical trial milestone, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or any other special-situations event is involved.
